Corporate Profile


華潤醫藥集團有限公司（股份代號：3320）是中    China Resources Pharmaceutical Group Limited (stock code: 3320) is a leading
國領先的綜合醫藥公司，業務範疇覆蓋醫藥及       integrated pharmaceutical company in China. Our business spans across
保健產品的生產、分銷及零售。本集團成立於       manufacturing, distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and healthcare
二零零七年，現已發展成中國前五大醫藥製造       products. Since the establishment in 2007, the Group has developed into one
商兼中國前三大醫藥產品分銷商（按收益）。本      of the fifth largest pharmaceutical manufacturers and the one of the third
公司於二零一六年十月在香港成功完成全球發       largest pharmaceutical distributors (by revenue) in China. In October 2016, the
售。                         Company successfully completed its global offering in Hong Kong. Since its
                           listing.

中 國 超 大 規 模 市 場 優 勢 明 顯，醫 藥 市 場 內 生 性         China’s ultra-large market affords a distinctive advantage. The pharmaceutical
驅 動 力 強 勁，醫 藥 產 業 弱 週 期 和 朝 陽 產 業 地 位         market enjoys a strong endogenous driving force, and the weak cycle
得 到 進 一 步 確 立。後 疫 情 時 代，在 需 求、政 策、            characteristic of pharmaceutical industry and status as a sunrise industry has
技 術、資 本 等 各 因 素 催 化 下，醫 藥 健 康 產 業 發           been further ascertained. Driven by demand, policy, technology, capital, and
展 空 間 廣 闊，吸 引 力 明 顯 提 升；產 業 鏈 條 與 市           other factors, the pharmaceutical and health industry will embrace broad
場 格 局 面 臨 加 快 重 塑；企 業 商 業 模 式 快 速 演           prospects for development in the post-pandemic era with a significantly
進。同 時，產 業 分 化 趨 勢 愈 加 清 晰，一 方 面，無             stronger appeal. The reshaping of the industry chain and market landscape
核 心 競 爭 能 力 的 中 小 型 藥 企 加 速 退 出，行 業 集         will occur at an accelerated pace, while enterprises will experience a rapid
中 度 日 益 提 升，另 一 方 面，具 有 行 業 整 合 與 創           evolution in business model. Meanwhile, a clearer trend of industry division will
新能力的大型優質企業的競爭優勢將更加突                           emerge: the exit of small and medium pharmaceutical enterprises lacking core
顯。                                            competitiveness will happen at a faster pace, resulting in increasing industry
                                              concentration. On the other hand, the competitive advantage of premium large

                                              more prominent.

前景與未來戰略                                 OUTLOOK AND FUTURE STRATEGY
二零二一年是「十四五」開局之年，本集團圍繞                   Year 2021 is the commencing year of the “14th Five-Year Plan (FYP)”. Pivoting
新形勢、新起點、新發展的要求，針對自身業務                   on requirements warranted by the new landscape, new starting point and
結 構 和 產 品 特 點，將「改 革 創 新、質 量 發 展」作       new development and taking into consideration its inherent business structure
為 管 理 主 題，加 大 研 發 投 入，力 爭 實 現 創 新 突     and product characteristics, the Group will adopt “Reform, Innovation and
破；加 大 外 延 併 購 力 度，高 度 關 注 潛 力 業 務 和     Qualitative Development” as its management theme and increase R&D
創 新 領 域 的 投 資 機 會；注 重 內 涵 發 展，降 本 增     investments to strive for innovation and breakthrough. Efforts in external
效，提高發展質量；提升數字化、智能化水平，                   merger and acquisition will be strengthened with a strong focus on investment
鼓勵模式創新，提高管理效率；強化風險防範，                   opportunities for potential businesses and innovative sectors. Emphasis will also
確 保 穩 健 經 營；持 續 優 化 業 務 組 合，積 極 佈 局     be placed on our internal development as we seek cost reductions, efficiency
產 業 鏈 關 鍵 環 節 和 潛 力 領 域，同 時 把 握 區 域 發   enhancement and improvements in the quality of development. Further

內部監控及風險管理                               INTERNAL CONTROL AND RISK MANAGEMENT
董 事 會 明 白，董 事 會 須 負 責 維 持 充 分 的 風 險 管   The Board acknowledges that it is the responsibility of the Board for
理 及 內 部 監 控 制 度，以 保 障 股 東 的 投 資 及 本 公   maintaining an adequate risk management and internal control systems to
司 的 資 產，並 每 年 審 閱 該 制 度 的 有 效 性。風 險     safeguard shareholder investments and Company assets and reviewing the
管理及內部監控系統可對重大錯誤陳述或損失                    effectiveness of such systems on an annual basis. The risk management and
提 供 合 理 而 非 絕 對 的 保 證，並 旨 在 管 理 而 非 消   internal control systems can provide reasonable and not absolute assurance
除在達致業務目標的過程中出現的失敗風險。                    against material misstatement or loss, and are designed to manage rather than
                                        eliminate the risk of failure in the process of attaining business objectives.

本集團已建立全面的風險管理及內部控制系                     The Group has established a comprehensive risk management and internal
統，並 極 為 重 視 其 製 藥、醫 藥 分 銷 及 藥 品 零 售     control system, and devoted significant attention to internal control measures
業 務 的 內 部 控 制 措 施。其 已 採 取 嚴 格 的 內 部 控   of its pharmaceutical manufacturing, pharmaceutical distribution and
制 措 施 及 經 營 程 式，以 監 管 從 研 發 到 生 產、分     pharmaceutical retail businesses. It has adopted stringent internal control
銷 及 零 售 的 醫 藥 價 值 鏈 各 個 環 節。本 集 團 內 部   measures and operating procedures to regulate all stages of its pharmaceutical
控 制 系 統 根 據 相 關 行 業 及 管 理 標 準（包 括GMP    value chain, from research and development to manufacturing, distribution
及GSP要 求）設 計。本 集 團 定 期 實 施 內 部 控 制       and retail. The Group’s internal control system is designed according to

   公允價值計量                              Fair value measurement
   本集團於各報告期末按公允價值計量其                   The Group measures its investment properties and equity investments
   投 資 物 業 及 股 權 投 資。公 允 價 值 乃 於 計     at fair value at the end of each reporting period. Fair value is the price
   量日期在市場參與者之間以有序交易中                   that would be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an
   出售資產所收到或轉移負債所支付的價                   orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement
   格。公允價值計量乃基於出售資產或轉移                  date. The fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the
   負債的交易發生在資產或負債的主要市                   transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either in the
   場（或 若 無 主 要 市 場，則 為 最 有 利 於 資 產     principal market for the asset or liability, or in the absence of a principal
   或 負 債 的 市 場）的 假 設 作 出。主 要 或 最 有     market, in the most advantageous market for the asset or liability. The
   利市場必須能夠讓本集團進行交易。資產                  principal or the most advantageous market must be accessible by the
   或負債的公允價值乃採用市場參與者為                   Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the
   資產或負債定價時將採用的假設計量，即                  assumptions that market participants would use when pricing the asset
   假設市場參與者按其最佳經濟利益行事。                  or liability, assuming that market participants act in their economic best
                                       interest.

   類為按公允價值計入損益計量。

   本集團管理金融資產的業務模式指其如                   The Group’s business model for managing financial assets refers to
   何管理其金融資產以產生現金流量。業務                  how it manages its financial assets in order to generate cash flows.
   模式確定現金流量是否來自收取合約現                   The business model determines whether cash flows will result from

     租賃－估計增量借款利率                          Leases – Estimating the incremental borrowing rate
     本集團無法輕易釐定租賃內所隱含的利                    The Group cannot readily determine the interest rate implicit in a lease,
     率，因此，使用增量借款利率（「增量借款                  and therefore, it uses an incremental borrowing rate (“IBR”) to measure
     利率」）計量租賃負債。增量借款利率為本                  lease liabilities. The IBR is the rate of interest that the Group would have
     集團於類似經濟環境中為取得與使用權                    to pay to borrow over a similar term, and with a similar security, the
     資產價值相近之資產，而以類似抵押品與                   funds necessary to obtain an asset of a similar value to the right-of-use
     類似期間借入所需資金應支付之利率。因                   asset in a similar economic environment. The IBR therefore reflects what
     此，增量借款利率反映了本集團「應支付」                  the Group “would have to pay”, which requires estimation when no
     的 利 率，當 無 可 觀 察 的 利 率 時（如 就 並 無      observable rates are available (such as for subsidiaries that do not enter
     訂立融資交易之附屬公司而言）或當須對                   into financing transactions) or when it needs to be adjusted to reflect the
     利率進行調整以反映租賃之條款及條件時                   terms and conditions of the lease (for example, when leases are not in
     （如 當 租 賃 並 非 以 附 屬 公 司 之 功 能 貨 幣     the subsidiary’s functional currency). The Group estimates the IBR using
     訂 立 時），則 須 作 出 利 率 估 計。當 可 觀 察       observable inputs (such as market interest rates) when available and is
     輸入數據可用時，本集團使用可觀察輸入                   required to make certain entity-specific estimates (such as the subsidiary’s
     數 據（如 市 場 利 率）估 算 增 量 借 款 利 率 並      stand-alone credit rating).
     須作出若干實體特定的估計（如附屬公司
     的獨立信貸評級）     。

40. 或然負債                                40. CONTINGENT LIABILITIES
   於截至二零二零年及二零一九年十二月                          During the years ended 31 December 2020 and 2019, the Group
   三十一日止年度，本集團(i)背書若干應收                       (i) endorsed certain bills receivable for the settlement of trade and
   票據以結算貿易及其他應付款項；及(ii)向                      other payables; and (ii) discounted certain bills receivable to banks
   銀行貼現若干應收票據以籌集現金。本公                         for raising cash. In the opinion of the directors of the Company, the
   司董事認為，本集團已將與該等應收票據                         Group has transferred the significant risks and rewards relating to
   有關的重大風險及回報轉移，且按照中國                         these bills receivable, and the Group’s obligations to the corresponding
   的商業慣例，本集團對相關對手方承擔的                         counterparties were discharged in accordance with the commercial
   責任已解除。拖欠支付已背書及已貼現應                         practice in the PRC. The risk of default in payment of the endorsed and
   收票據的風險較低，原因是所有已背書及                         discounted bills receivable is low because all endorsed and discounted
